summary: Iter33 verifies the axios request-interceptor fix in /app/frontend/src/App.js (SLOW_API_PATTERN → 180000ms; 30000ms remains the default for everything else). USER-FACING Phase 1 flow is now FIXED end-to-end in the browser: admin@swu.ac.th logs in → creates a Conjoint study → /research/conjoint/{id}/qualitative → adds Thai interview text → clicks 'เริ่มวิเคราะห์'. The POST /api/conjoint/studies/{id}/qualitative-analysis completes at 43,498ms (console line: 'Slow request: ...qualitative-analysis took 43498ms' — emitted by the response interceptor after the request came back 200) and the UI renders 'ผลการวิเคราะห์ (รอบที่ 1)' with Thai attributes (ระดับความหวาน / ส่วนผสมหลัก / …) and their levels (หวานน้อย/ปานกลาง/มาก, ชาไทยล้วน/ใส่นมสด/กลิ่นมะลิ, …). No error toast, no ECONNABORTED, no 'timeout of 30000ms exceeded' — proving the 30s default no longer cancels the ~43s Claude call. Test study created and purged (DELETE + /purge both 200). Regression: conjoint-analysis list loads in 1.6s, /brand-equity list in 1.3s, public /brand-equity/respond/demosimchathai in 0.9s, none hang or spinner-stall. Non-slow paths still use axios.defaults.timeout=30000 as designed. LLM/stats flows (hierarchical_bayes, mixed_logit, compare, BE dashboard/score-history/segment-significance, conjoint thesis export, ai-*/interpretation/generate-*) were NOT individually re-tested per main-agent's 'LLM calls cost credits: one run per flow' constraint — they all match SLOW_API_PATTERN and inherit the same 180s window, so the fix is uniformly applied by construction. The retest matches the fix's design and iter32's action item is closed.
action_items: Safe to redeploy to swumkt.org — Phase 1 Qualitative Analysis timeout bug is resolved end-to-end.

Optional follow-up (not blocking): the SLOW_API_PATTERN regex uses substring segments like /dashboard and /interpretation which are broad — any future non-LLM endpoint whose path happens to contain 'dashboard' or 'compare' will also silently get a 180s window. Consider anchoring with '/api/(...)|(...)' or an allow-list of full path prefixes if you want stricter scoping. Not urgent.
critical_code_review_comments: SLOW_API_PATTERN matches any substring — e.g. any URL containing '/dashboard' anywhere (including hypothetical /api/admin/dashboard/quick-count) will get the 180s window even if it is a fast endpoint. This is safe (only affects timeout, not behavior), but tightening to explicit path prefixes would prevent accidental broadening.

The interceptor mutates config.timeout in place and does not restore the default afterward — that is correct (each request gets a fresh config), just noting no leakage across requests. Confirmed working as designed.

success_rate.frontend: 100% on the Phase 1 flow + regression pages

context_for_next_testing_agent: The axios interceptor in /app/frontend/src/App.js lines 84-107 is the authoritative fix. When testing any Claude-backed synchronous UI call, watch for the console line 'Slow request: <url> took <ms>ms' — that confirms the interceptor's response handler saw the call complete rather than aborting it. If a call still aborts, the URL likely does not match SLOW_API_PATTERN and needs to be added. On this preview URL a service worker is active ('SW controller changed / New SW activated, reloading') which will drop any localStorage token you set BEFORE the SW reload — set the token only AFTER a real load (or drive login through the form) or your fetch() calls will 401. The Phase 1 result-page heading is 'ผลการวิเคราะห์', not 'คุณสมบัติที่แนะนำ' — use that string (or check for the attribute names / step indicator advancing) when asserting success.
rca_of_the_issue: Iter32 identified LAYER 2: axios.defaults.timeout=30000 cancelled the ~43s Claude call before the response arrived, so the user saw 'ไม่สามารถวิเคราะห์ข้อมูลได้' toast even though the backend returned 200. The developer's fix adds an axios request interceptor: on every request, if the URL matches SLOW_API_PATTERN (regex covering qualitative-analysis, statistical-analysis, ai-analysis/analyze/suggest/needs/step/interpretation, interpretation, thesis, export-thesis, generate-image/questions, regenerate-questions, compare, score-history, segment-significance, dashboard), the request's timeout is bumped to 180000ms; otherwise the global 30000ms default still applies. Verified in browser: POST qualitative-analysis for TEST_iter33_1786722290 finished at 43498ms with status 200 and the UI rendered the Thai attribute suggestions. The user's original reproduction case is now green.
